```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidymodels)
library(doParallel)
library(outliers) # grubbs.test
library(stringr) # string processing
library(isotree) # Outlier detection via isolation forest
library(gmodels) # CrossTable()

# tidymodels helper package
library(embed)
library(kknn)
library(discrim)
library(baguette)
library(rules)
library(earth)

tidymodels_prefer()
```

```{r}
combined_augmented_data = read.csv("combined_augmented_data.csv")
combined_augmented_data = combined_augmented_data %>% select(-cAb13)
# Retain variant value, replace replicate value with a rowname column to identify
# each sample. Color the final heatmap by the variant value and store prediction history
# alongisde rowname
fluorescence_sums = rowSums(combined_augmented_data %>% select(starts_with('cAb')))
avg_fluorescence = rowMeans(combined_augmented_data %>% select(starts_with('cAb')))

labeled_augmented_data = combined_augmented_data %>% select(-Replicate) %>% 
  mutate("SampleNum" = row.names(combined_augmented_data), .before = Conc.) %>% 
  filter(Conc. > 0.1)
```

```{r}
# Model specifications and recipe generation
set.seed(0703)

initial_split = initial_split(labeled_augmented_data, strata = target_vector)
train_data = training(initial_split)
test_data = testing(initial_split)
training_folds = vfold_cv(train_data, strata = target_vector, repeats = 2)

# Distributions of concentration in the training and test set aren't crazy different...I suppose
train_data %>% mutate(across(Conc., as.factor)) %>% count(Conc.) %>% mutate(perc = n/nrow(train_data)*100)
test_data %>% mutate(across(Conc., as.factor)) %>% count(Conc.) %>% mutate(perc = n/nrow(test_data)*100)

train_data %>% ggplot(aes(x=Conc.)) + geom_density() + scale_x_log10()
test_data %>% ggplot(aes(x=Conc.)) + geom_density() + scale_x_log10()
```
```{r}
# Let's set up two basic recipes, one where we normalize out predictors and another where we create polynomial expansions
normalized_rec = recipe(target_vector~., data = train_data) %>% 
  update_role(SampleNum, Conc., new_role = 'id') %>% 
  step_normalize(all_predictors())

# NOTE: BOTH RECIPES NORMALIZE PREDICTORS CURRENTLY
poly_recipe = normalized_rec %>% 
  step_poly(all_predictors()) %>% 
  step_interact(~all_predictors():all_predictors())

no_pre_proc_rec = recipe(target_vector~., data = train_data) %>% 
  update_role(SampleNum, Conc., new_role = 'id')
```

```{r}
log_reg_spec = multinom_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine("glmnet") %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

nnet_spec = mlp(hidden_units = tune(), penalty = tune(), epoch = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine('nnet', MaxNWts = 2600) %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

mars_spec = mars(num_terms = tune(), prod_degree = tune(), prune_method = 'backward') %>% 
  set_engine('earth') %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

svm_r_spec = svm_rbf(cost = tune(), rbf_sigma = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine('kernlab') %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

svm_p_spec = svm_poly(cost = tune(), degree = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine("kernlab") %>% 
  set_mode("classification")

# QDA with no regularization
qda_spec = discrim_quad() %>% 
  set_engine('MASS') %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

knn_spec = nearest_neighbor(neighbors = tune(), dist_power = tune(), weight_func = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine('kknn') %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

bag_cart_spec = bag_tree() %>% 
  set_engine('rpart', times = 50L) %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

rf_spec = rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 1000) %>% 
  set_engine('ranger') %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

xgb_spec = boost_tree(tree_depth = tune(), learn_rate = tune(), loss_reduction = tune(), 
              min_n = tune(), sample_size = tune(), trees = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine('xgboost') %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

# Update some parameters
nnet_param = 
  nnet_spec %>% 
  extract_parameter_set_dials() %>% 
  update(hidden_units = hidden_units(c(1, 27)))

rf_params = rf_spec %>% 
  extract_parameter_set_dials() %>% 
  update(mtry = mtry(c(1, 10)))
```

```{r}
# Now we can generate a set of workflows
normalized_wfs = workflow_set(
  preproc = list(normalized = normalized_rec),
  models = list(SVM_radial = svm_r_spec, SVM_poly = svm_p_spec, 
                    KNN = knn_spec, neural_network = nnet_spec,
                    QDA = qda_spec)
)

# To change the parameters of a certain workflow within the set, we can use option_add
# The results column is a placeholder which will contain the tuning/resampling results from the given workflow
normalized_wfs = normalized_wfs %>% option_add(param_info = nnet_param, id = 'normalized_neural_network')
normalized_wfs
```
```{r}
no_preproc_wfs = workflow_set(
  preproc = list(simple = no_pre_proc_rec),
  models = list(MARS = mars_spec, CART_bagged = bag_cart_spec,
                    RF = rf_spec, boosting = xgb_spec)
)

no_preproc_wfs = no_preproc_wfs %>% option_add(param_info = rf_params, id = 'simple_RF')
```

```{r}
poly_features_wfs = workflow_set(
  preproc = list(full_quad = poly_recipe),
  models = list(log_reg = log_reg_spec, KNN = knn_spec)
)
```

```{r}
all_workflows = 
  bind_rows(no_preproc_wfs, normalized_wfs, poly_features_wfs) %>% 
  mutate(wflow_id = gsub("(simple_)|(normalized_)", "", wflow_id))

all_workflows
```
```{r}
grid_ctrl = control_grid(
  save_pred = TRUE,
  parallel_over = "everything",
  save_workflow = TRUE
)

grid_results = all_workflows %>% 
  workflow_map(
    seed = 0703,
    resamples = training_folds,
    grid = 25,
    control = grid_ctrl
  )
for (val in 1:11){
  print(grid_results[val,]$result)
}
grid_results = grid_results %>% filter(wflow_id != 'MARS')
# Obtain models that had a functioning resampling loop
# grid_results_functional = grid_results %>% filter(wflow_id != 'KNN', wflow_id != 'full_quad_KNN', wflow_id != 'MARS', wflow_id != 'Cubist', wflow_id != 'full_quad_log_reg')

grid_results %>% rank_results()
```

```{r}
autoplot(grid_results,
         rank_metric = 'roc_auc',
         metric = 'roc_auc',
         select_best = TRUE # Returns one point per workflow
         ) + 
  geom_text(aes(y = mean - 0.05, label = wflow_id), angle = 90, hjust = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(y = mean + 0.05, label = round(mean, 3))) +
  lims(y=c(0, 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = 'none')

autoplot(grid_results,
         rank_metric = 'accuracy',
         metric = 'accuracy',
         select_best = TRUE # Returns one point per workflow
         ) + 
  geom_text(aes(y = mean - 0.05, label = wflow_id), angle = 90, hjust = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(y = mean + 0.05, label = round(mean, 3))) +
  lims(y=c(0, 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = 'none')


autoplot(grid_results,
         id  = 'neural_network',
         metric = 'roc_auc')
```
```{r}
# Testing final model performance for optimal models
best_nn_results = grid_results %>% 
  extract_workflow_set_result("neural_network") %>% 
  select_best(metric = "roc_auc")

nn_test_results <- 
   grid_results %>% 
   extract_workflow("neural_network") %>% 
   finalize_workflow(best_nn_results) %>% 
   last_fit(split = initial_split)

collect_metrics(nn_test_results)


best_rf_results = grid_results %>% 
  extract_workflow_set_result("RF") %>% 
  select_best(metric = 'roc_auc')

rf_test_results <- 
   grid_results %>% 
   extract_workflow("RF") %>% 
   finalize_workflow(best_rf_results) %>% 
   last_fit(split = initial_split)

collect_metrics(rf_test_results)
collect_predictions(rf_test_results)

best_xgb_results = grid_results %>% 
  extract_workflow_set_result("boosting") %>% 
  select_best(metric = 'roc_auc')

xgb_test_results <- 
   grid_results %>% 
   extract_workflow("boosting") %>% 
   finalize_workflow(best_xgb_results) %>% 
   last_fit(split = initial_split)

collect_metrics(xgb_test_results)


best_qda_results = grid_results %>% 
  extract_workflow_set_result("QDA") %>% 
  select_best(metric = 'roc_auc')

qda_test_results <- 
   grid_results %>% 
   extract_workflow("QDA") %>% 
   finalize_workflow(best_qda_results) %>% 
   last_fit(split = initial_split)

collect_metrics(qda_test_results)


best_svm_poly_results = grid_results %>% 
  extract_workflow_set_result("SVM_poly") %>% 
  select_best(metric = 'roc_auc')

svm_poly_test_results <- 
   grid_results %>% 
   extract_workflow("SVM_poly") %>% 
   finalize_workflow(best_svm_poly_results) %>% 
   last_fit(split = initial_split)

collect_metrics(svm_poly_test_results)

# So every model takes about a 7-10% hit in accuracy, and a slightly smaller hit to roc_auc for the testing set
rf_test_preds = collect_predictions(rf_test_results)
rf_best_preds = collect_best_predictions(rf_test_results)
test_label = labeled_augmented_data[rf_test_preds$.row,]
test_label
rf_conf = analyze_confidence(rf_best_preds$best_param_probs,
                   labeled_augmented_data$Conc.,
                   rf_test_preds$.row,)

rf_conf
```
